english: If I get carried away, my very existence could be in danger...
Well, I thought there might be a clue...
What? Do I look that generous to you?\f............
All right! I get it! Stop looking at me like that!
Here. Take this and get going.
Hurry up and find that black-market broker!
.........\fYou idiot! It's a matter of pride!\fI'll pace this bridge till the end of the game!
Hey, this is kind of awkward to ask...
What do you mean, well? A Gin Tama broker... Hmm...\fSorry, Gin. Never heard of one.
Hey, Gin. Found that broker yet?
I'm after a Gin Tama broker. Know one?
Hey, don't go making me the villain.
If YOU think he's shady, he must be bad.
If I had cash to spare, I wouldn't need a broker!
What do you mean, how? He's suspicious.
Your dad? Oh, the bald bubble guy...\fGetting along now, huh? Good for you.
Just thought I'd see the happy family...
Huh?! Weren't you collecting Gin Tama too?
Idiot. I'm meeting Dad. We're going shopping.
We're done, right? Get lost already!
Y-you idiot! That's not it!\f............\fHere! Take this and get lost.
I don't fight small fry. Don't need it.
Keep bugging me and I'll turn that perm into a punch perm.
Want a summer job at my beach shack?
Come work for me. I'll throw in cola too.
You fought that prince, right?\fA prince must have loads of good Gin Tama. Tough fight?
That idiot prince was hanging around... Where'd he go?
Nah, easy... He's got weaknesses galore.\fFat, short, dumb, Amanto... No contest. Oh... I'm Amanto too.
Quit making up your own rules.
Has the booze reached your brain too?
Keep it down, you drunk! You're a nuisance!
What are you thinking?! This is why I hate rich people.
Oh, right! I must live long for Kanshichiro!
Kanshichiro! Grow up big and strong!
What birthday gift for my grandson Kanshichiro?
What if Kanshichiro grows up to be like you...?
Well, thanks. Don't mind if I do.
Feeding pond carp. Didn't come all the way to Earth for that.
Yeah, I will. You're a nice guy. Have this Gin Tama.
Actually, a space captain's scouting me too.
Huh? On your own today, Hamuko?
What's wrong with an honest day's work?
Hmm... Personally, your way of talking bugs me more.
Tasuke left me Gin Tama? Really?!
For me, rather than using them himself...
Well, that does sound like him...
No, don't.\fYour weaknesses are way too obvious, Hamuko...
Yeah! Tasuke ditched me and went to work!\fLike, I can't believe him!
I know, but it's sooo annoying!
Like, I can't believe YOU!\fI was holding some Gin Tama Tasuke left for you, too!
Really! Remember how those Amanto hurt Tasuke before?\fHe wants you to use these Gin Tama to beat them in battle.
Ahh... Maybe I should try Gin Tama battles too.
Don't lump me in with him! Never heard of Yorozuya Gin?
Oh, right... So where'd you see him?
Who the hell are you?! With that shady guy, are you?
He's suspicious BECAUSE I don't know him!
Hey, you... Yorozuya... Gold? Silver? Pearls? Prizes?\fWhat am I even saying?
I mean, he's suspicious enough to look suspicious.
N-no! What are you talking about?
What do you mean, besides me?! You calling ME suspicious?!
We're not pals! And stop calling me factory chief!
So annoying! Just get going already!
Brooding here and plotting trouble again?
Anyway, got a question.\fSeen anyone suspicious here, besides yourself?
Now, now. So? Did you see anyone or not?
Right... Thanks, chief!\fDon't go mass-producing Justaways for another evil scheme!
Oh, right... You're a helpful guy, chief.
Someone's idea of a prank. What a nuisance.
All right! I get it! Points for trying. Don't strain yourself.
How should I know, idiot? I've got bigger problems.
I've got no money to lend you!
Why are you hanging around here?
I see... All sorts flock to the neon lights.
Well, all this nightlife's left me broke.
Gin, got time to relax today?
Be careful, Gin... Don't lose to that sickly-looking Amanto.
More Amanto customers lately. Good for business, but...
Of all times for Otae to be away...
Not working here anymore? What a waste...
Using our club for shady deals... That cat bastard's banned!
Low on Gin Tama after fighting that cat Amanto? Take these.
Don't tell Mama I gave you Gin Tama...
Now, now. Let's say both are thin.\fAnyway, that zombie you mentioned...
Hmm... Zombie or not, that's definitely suspicious...
Right... I'll try a few things next time.
Well? How's the Gin Tama collecting going?
Heh... Sounds like you're having a rough time.
Right. Learn by doing. Keep at it!
Hey, you look pale. You okay?
Ngh... I won't lose to a mere urge to poop...!
Hey, don't you dare tell anyone!
Wait a moment. There's still some omelet left...
Got prisms in your eyes?!\fDo I look like a kid?! I'm this big, you bastard!
It's fine. I can go myself...
Want me to walk you home?
